name: FDA approves imlunestrant with abemaciclib
summary: The US FDA approved imlunestrant (Inluriyo) with abemaciclib on 18 September 2026 for ER-positive, HER2-negative, ESR1-mutated advanced breast cancer.
keyPoints: The US FDA approved imlunestrant (Inluriyo) with abemaciclib (Verzenio) on 18 September 2026.
It applies to adults with ER-positive, HER2-negative, ESR1-mutated advanced or metastatic breast cancer.
The FDA also approved the Guardant360 CDx test to identify ESR1 mutations.
This is a US decision; UK availability is decided separately.

body.heading: What was announced
body.body:
On 18 September 2026 the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved imlunestrant (Inluriyo) in combination with abemaciclib (Verzenio).

The approval is for adults with ER-positive, HER2-negative, ESR1-mutated advanced or metastatic breast cancer.

The FDA also approved the Guardant360 CDx assay as a companion diagnostic to identify breast cancers with ESR1 mutations for treatment with imlunestrant and abemaciclib.

body.heading: What it means
body.body:
The FDA says the approval rests on the EMBER-3 trial, in which patients were randomly assigned to imlunestrant, standard endocrine therapy, or imlunestrant with abemaciclib.

The FDA had approved imlunestrant alone in September 2025 for ESR1-mutated disease that had progressed after at least one line of endocrine therapy.

This is a US decision; availability in the UK is decided separately by the MHRA and NICE.
